messages:
sre-bot: ALERT ReservedPool(us-west-2:d-ed-01) saturation=96% for 14m — admission-controller engaged, throttling new dedicated requests.

james: getting client reports of 429s and increased queueing on dedicated endpoints. noticed spike around 10:14 UTC.

maria: looking at pool metrics now, reserved pool ingress is steady high, burst pool at ~82% and burst_quota=0.

devon: any autoscale activity? last autoscale attempt shows quota_limit_exceeded errors in AZ a.

capacity-controller: AutoscaleAttempt(id=atk-20260318-1016) -> failed: AwsQuotaExceeded(GPUInstances: 0 available in us-west-2a).

james: so we can't spin more nodes in the same AZ. distribution across AZs is already uneven.

eva: latency to eu-west fallback is +120ms for some customers but better than 429s. suggest temporary overflow routing for non-SLA tenants.

maria: agreed. propose triage steps: 1) demote internal/staging weights, 2) overflow non-committed tenants to eu-west, 3) open cloud quota request, 4) short-term traffic shaping (per-tenant rate limit).

james: current fairshare config snippet:
```
fairshare_weights:
  enterprise: 0.7
  standard: 0.2
  internal: 0.1
```

james: we can reduce internal -> 0.02 and standard -> 0.15 to free headroom.

devon: can we evict staging jobs? those are low priority and long-running. I can kick off eviction.

ops-oncall: evicting staging now (marking shards). will drain 4 instances from reserved pool. ETA ~6m. :hourglass: 

sre-bot: Update: 4 staging workloads drained, reserved pool saturation -> 89% after drains. Admission throttle still active.

maria: initiating overflow policy for tenants tagged "non-sla" to eu-west route. applying in console now.

capacity-controller: FlowRule applied: overflow(non-sla) -> eu-west-1, max-rps 1200, prefer-local false.

james: rolling config patch to lower internal weight and enable overflow. patch: `rbac:apply patch-178120`

jeva: (typo) eva: rolling now. watch for errors.

sre-bot: Note: burst pool remaining burst_quota=0, continuing to serve queued requests, but at reduced throughput.

maria: after overflow routing and evictions, observed 429s drop by ~78%, p95 latency for dedicated endpoints back to baseline ~85ms.

devon: opened ticket to cloud provider for additional GPU quota in us-west-2; ticket #CLOUD-98745. requested emergency increase and AZ rebalancing.

james: follow-ups: (1) schedule planned migration for non-critical tenants to eu-west until quota resolved, (2) add extra quota alarms to prevent repeating, (3) run post-incident analysis to tweak fairshare defaults and burst_quota thresholds.

ops-oncall: documenting steps in runbook and adding temporary annotation to reserved pool: "saturation-mitigation-apr2026".

maria: thanks everyone — keeping this thread open until cloud provider responds. :white_check_mark:
